headline: Vivara Shares Lead Ibovespa Declines Following Third-Quarter Results
summary: Jewelry retailer Vivara reported a net income of R$114.8 million for the third quarter, down 38.7% compared to the same period of the previous year, leading losses on the Ibovespa index.
why: Earnings contractions relative to prior periods signal lower consumer discretionary spending or compressed margins, frequently triggering sharp downward pressure on retail equity prices.

impacts.name: Vivara
impacts.why: A 38.7% drop in net income directly hurts company fundamentals and depresses share value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A significant profit decline reported for the third quarter disappointed investors, causing the stock to drop and lead losses on the index.
